name: PSP
recent: PSP Energy Berhad 将于 2026 年 12 月 18 日召开第二届年度股东大会。公司董事 Puan Rafidah binti Bahtiar 在 2026 年 8 月至 10 月期间多次减持股份。公司截至 2026 年 6 月 30 日止季度营收环比增长 13.1%，净利环比增长 33.5%。
notable: 将于 2026 年 12 月 18 日召开第二届年度股东大会。
董事 Puan Rafidah binti Bahtiar 在 2026 年 8 月至 10 月期间多次减持股份。
截至 2026 年 6 月 30 日止季度营收环比增长 13.1%，净利环比增长 33.5%。
risks: 董事 Puan Rafidah binti Bahtiar 在 2026 年 8 月至 10 月期间多次减持股份。
股东大会将审议豁免股东法定优先认购权及发行新股的议案。
earnings: 截至 2026 年 6 月 30 日止季度，营收为 RM316,229,000，环比增长 13.1%；净利为 RM9,332,000，环比增长 33.5%；净利率为 3.0%，高于上一季度的 2.5%。

recent_en: Director Puan Rafidah binti Bahtiar disposed of shares multiple times between August and October 2026. The company's quarterly revenue for the period ended 30 June 2026 rose 13.1% QoQ, with net profit up 33.5% QoQ.
notable_en: Second Annual General Meeting scheduled for 18 December 2026.
Director Puan Rafidah binti Bahtiar disposed of shares multiple times between August and October 2026.
Quarterly revenue for the period ended 30 June 2026 rose 13.1% QoQ, with net profit up 33.5% QoQ.
risks_en: Director Puan Rafidah binti Bahtiar disposed of shares multiple times between August and October 2026.
The AGM will consider a proposed waiver of statutory pre-emptive rights and authority to issue new shares.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was RM316,229,000, up 13.1% QoQ; net profit was RM9,332,000, up 33.5% QoQ; net margin was 3.0%, higher than 2.5% in the previous quarter.
